title: Oven-Roasted Turkish Lamb Adana Kebap
description: A peppery, creamy, light Turkish dish featuring dried cranberries, served as a whole30-friendly adana kebap.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt, black pepper, ground cumin, and ground coriander.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2 minutes per side.
Transfer the lamb shoulder to a baking sheet and roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
While the lamb is roasting, mix the minced garlic with the dried cranberries, chopped parsley, lemon juice, and Greek yogurt in a bowl.
After the lamb has roasted for 20 minutes, brush it with the garlic-cranberry mixture and continue to roast for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the lamb from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it thinly against the grain.
Serve the sliced lamb with additional garlic-cranberry sauce, if desired.
